regulations.rationale: Device approval for the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions; it consolidates R7 and R23. (Device approval. Scope: This Regulation applies to the following light-signalling devices (lamps): • Rear-registration plate illuminating lamps • Direction indicator lamps • Position lamps • Stop lamps • End-outline marker lamps • Reversing lamps • Manoeuvring... Spec terms 12.1, obligation base 12.9.)

Installation regulation for lighting and light-signalling devices on M1 vehicles. (Installation regulation. Scope: This Regulation applies to vehicles of categories M, N, and to their trailers (category O) with regard to the installation of lighting and light-signalling devices. Spec terms 30.1, obligation base 36.2.)

Device approval for the built-in retro-reflector (Class IA/IB); it consolidates R3. (Device approval. Scope: This Regulation applies to retro-reflective devices as: • Retro-reflectors of the Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA • Retro-reflective Marking Materials of the Classes C, D, E and F, D/E • Retro-reflective Marking Plates for Heavy and L... Spec terms 3.9, obligation base 3.1.)

The lamp contains LED electronics on a PCB, which makes it an electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) subject to EMC requirements. (Electromagnetic compatibility. Scope: This Regulation applies to: Vehicles of categories L, M, N O, T, R and S1 with regard to electromagnetic compatibility; Components and separate technical units intended to be fitted in these vehicles with the limitation given in paragrap... Spec terms 9.3, obligation base 8.0.)

The LED modules are built into the lamp, not replaceable R128 light-source categories, so they are approved with the lamp. (Light sources. Scope: This Regulation applies to LED light sources shown in Annex 1 and intended for use in approved lamps of power-driven vehicles and of their trailers. Spec terms 8.5, obligation base 9.4.)

Legacy regulation consolidated into R148. (Device approval. Scope: This Regulation applies to: Front and rear position lamps and stop lamps for vehicles of categories L, M, N, O and T; and, End-outline marker lamps for vehicles of categories M, N, O and T. Consolidated into UN R148. Spec terms 1.5, obligation base 2.1.)

Legacy regulation consolidated into R148. (Device approval. Scope: This Regulation applies to: (a) Reversing lamps for vehicles of categories M, N, O, and T; (b) Manoeuvring lamps for vehicles of categories M and N. Consolidated into UN R148. Spec terms 1.5, obligation base 1.2.)

Legacy regulation consolidated into R150. (Device approval. Scope: This Regulation applies to retro-reflecting devices for vehicles of categories L, M, N, O, and T. Consolidated into UN R150. Spec terms 0.4, obligation base 0.0.)

Vehicle-level regulation on external projections, not a requirement on the lamp as a component. (Vehicle approval. Scope: This Regulation applies to external projections of category M1 vehicles. It does not apply to exterior devices for indirect vision or to the ball of towing devices. The purpose of this Regulation is to reduce the risk or seriousness of b... Spec terms 0.4, obligation base 0.0.)

There are no replaceable filament light sources. (Light sources. Scope: This Regulation applies to filament light sources and their LED replacement light sources shown in Annex 1 and intended for use in approved lamps of power-driven vehicles and of their trailers. Spec terms 0.4, obligation base 9.4.)

Covers road illumination devices; not applicable. (Device approval. Scope: This Regulation applies to the following road illumination devices (lamps): • Headlamps emitting a driving-beam and/or an asymmetrical passing-beam for vehicles of categories L, M, N and T • Adaptive front-lighting systems (AFS) for vehi... Spec terms 4.2, obligation base 1.6.)

Covers safety glazing and excludes glazing for lighting devices. (Installation regulation. Scope: This Regulation applies to: (a) Safety glazing materials intended for installation as windscreens or other panes, or as partitioning, on vehicles of category L with bodywork, M, N, O, and T1; (b) Vehicles of category M, N and O with rega... Spec terms 2.8, obligation base 2.0.)

No rear fog lamp function, and the regulation is legacy. (Device approval. Scope: This Regulation applies to rear fog lamps for vehicles of categories L3, L4, L5, L7, M, N, O, and T1. Consolidated into UN R148. Spec terms 0.7, obligation base 0.3.)

Covers vehicle braking performance, not the stop lamp. (Vehicle approval. Scope: This Regulation applies to the braking of vehicles of categories M1 and N1. This Regulation does not cover: Spec terms 0.4, obligation base 0.0.)

profile.product: Rear lamp: an exterior lighting and signalling module that combines a rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, outer lens and retro-reflector in one housing
functions: Rear position signalling (presence/visibility) - rear position lamp
Light transmission and colour definition - outer lens
materials: Reflector surface: PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating
Light source: LED modules on PCB
Fasteners / clips: PA, POM, or steel

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.quote: The four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of, if applicable, on lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.quote: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of front or rear position lamps, front or rear end-outline marker lamps.
requirements.quote: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of: (b) Front or rear position lamps, front or rear end-outline marker lamps;

requirements.text: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating: (a) The category or categories of light source(s) prescribed;

requirements.text: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), also bear a marking indicating the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.quote: (b) in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s);

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with an electronic light source control gear.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with: (a) An electronic light source control gear;

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with a variable luminous intensity control.
requirements.quote: (b) A variable luminous intensity control;

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with a secondary operating mode.
requirements.quote: (c) A secondary operating mode;

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with non-replaceable light sources.
requirements.quote: (d) Non-replaceable light sources.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.quote: (a) On the light source module(s): (i) The trade name or mark of the applicant;

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module.
requirements.quote: (ii) The specific identification code of the module;

requirements.text: In case several non-identical light source modules are used, the specific identification code of the module shall be followed by additional symbols or characters.
requirements.quote: In case several non-identical light source modules are used, followed by additional symbols or characters;

requirements.text: The approval mark in the specific identification code of the light source module does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant.
requirements.quote: The approval mark does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant;

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.quote: (iii) The rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
requirements.quote: (b) On the lamp: (i) The specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii);

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.quote: (ii) The rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations and a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number is affixed, this marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that it is visible after their installation.
requirements.quote: It is visible after their installation;

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations and a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number is affixed, this marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.quote: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, using a common light source and designed to operate permanently with an additional system to regulate the intensity of the light emitted, these functions shall, where not provided by multiple light sources, be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps, and a note shall be made within the communication document.
requirements.quote: (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.

requirements.text: On request of the applicant, the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) may incorporate only one manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled and in addition the conditions of paragraph 4.5.5. (a) to (d) are met.
requirements.quote: On request of the applicant, the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) may incorporate only one manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled and in addition the following conditions:
atomic: Where a manufacturer logo is incorporated inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) of the rear lamp, only one manufacturer logo shall be incorporated.
Where a manufacturer logo is incorporated inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) of the rear lamp, all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation shall be fulfilled.

requirements.text: Where the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) incorporates a manufacturer logo, irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed, and this shall be confirmed by the applicant by a statement (see paragraph 3.1.2.2. (f)).
requirements.quote: (a) Irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed.

requirements.text: Where the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) incorporates a manufacturer logo, the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.quote: (b) Size: the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.

requirements.text: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.quote: (d) Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
atomic: The stop lamp shall not incorporate a logo.
The reversing lamp shall not incorporate a logo.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, where a tell-tale failure signal is not produced, the light intensity shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded.
requirements.quote: (a) The light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or
atomic: Where provision (a) is applied, in case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, the light intensity of the lamp shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3.
Where provision (a) is applied, when all light sources of the lamp are illuminated, the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, where the light intensity does not comply with the minimum intensity required in Annex 3, a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, shall be produced, and a note in the communication form shall state that the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.quote: (b) A signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.quote: (a) The design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one;

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, and the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed applies.
requirements.quote: (b) The light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061. The holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed, applies.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.quote: (a) it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s); and
atomic: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the light source module can only be fitted in the designated and correct position.
In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the light source module can only be removed with the use of tool(s).

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
requirements.quote: (b) it is tamperproof; and

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.quote: (c) regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with: - any replaceable UN approved light source; and/or, - any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
atomic: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module shall not be interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source.

In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module shall not be interchangeable with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.
requirements.quote: (d) when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.quote: (a) On the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.;

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.quote: (b) In no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum, specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.;

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.quote: (c) Outside the reference axis, - be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question,

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, alternatively be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.quote: or - be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question;

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.quote: (d) Within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.

requirements.text: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities outside the range specified in paragraph 5.
requirements.quote: Outside the range specified in paragraph 5.;

requirements.text: If a rear position lamp and/or a rear end-outline marker lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp or end-outline marker lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
requirements.quote: If a rear position lamp and/or a rear end-outline marker lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp or end-outline marker lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.

requirements.text: If the one or both of the two reciprocally incorporated lamps contain(s) more than one light source and is (are) considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered are those obtained with all sources in operation.
requirements.quote: If the one or both of the two reciprocally incorporated lamps contain(s) more than one light source and is (are) considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered are those obtained with all sources in operation;

requirements.text: For a stop lamp of category S1 (steady), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 6.0∙101 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), a maximum luminous intensity of 2.60∙102 cd when used as a single lamp and 1.30∙102 cd when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.) (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2- 1, a minimum luminous intensity of 3∙10-1 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), as specified in Table 7.
atomic: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the stop lamp of category S1 (steady) shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)).
When used as a single lamp, the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the stop lamp of category S1 (steady) shall have a maximum luminous intensity of 2.60∙10^2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).

When used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the stop lamp of category S1 (steady) shall have a maximum luminous intensity of 1.30∙10^2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).
The stop lamp of category S1 (steady) shall meet the standard light distribution defined in Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)).
The stop lamp of category S1 (steady) shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 3∙10^-1 cd within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)).

requirements.text: For a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 6.0∙101 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), a maximum luminous intensity of 7.30∙102 cd when used as a single lamp and 3.65∙102 cd when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.) (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2- 1, a minimum luminous intensity of 3∙10-1 cd (day) and 7∙10-2 cd (night) (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), as specified in Table 7.
atomic: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the stop lamp of category S2 (variable) shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)).

When used as a single lamp, the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the stop lamp of category S2 (variable) shall have a maximum luminous intensity of 7.30∙10^2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).

When used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the stop lamp of category S2 (variable) shall have a maximum luminous intensity of 3.65∙10^2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).
The stop lamp of category S2 (variable) shall meet the standard light distribution defined in Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)).
The stop lamp of category S2 (variable) shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 3∙10^-1 cd (day) within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)).
The stop lamp of category S2 (variable) shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 7∙10^-2 cd (night) within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)).

requirements.text: When verifying the conformity of production of lamps with the requirements set forth in paragraph 5., no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.quote: No measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.

requirements.text: In the case where front and rear position lamps are intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.quote: However, in the case where one of the following lamps is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards: ... (b) Front and rear position lamps;

requirements.text: In the case where stop lamps of category S1, S2 and MS are intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.quote: However, in the case where one of the following lamps is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards: ... (e) Stop lamps of category S1, S2 and MS;

requirements.text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the front and rear position lamp (function) is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at a time after switch ON of 4 seconds, with reference coordinate HV, as listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.quote: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1. ... Front and rear position 4 HV

requirements.text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the stop lamp (function) is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at a time after switch ON of 0.2 seconds, with reference coordinate HV, as listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.quote: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1. ... Stop 0.2 HV

requirements.text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the reversing lamp (function) is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at a time after switch ON of 0.2 seconds, with reference coordinate HV, as listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.quote: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1. ... Reversing 0.2 HV

requirements.text: In case a lamp (function) uses more than one light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested following the strictest time requirements according to paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. for the combination of them and checked for compliance.
requirements.quote: In case a lamp (function) uses more than one light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested following the strictest time requirements according to paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. for the combination of them and checked for compliance.

requirements.text: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
requirements.quote: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.quote: Be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.);

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.quote: Be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp;

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.quote: Satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, in case of lamps constituting a pair incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle

requirements.text: All logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
requirements.quote: All logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, except that these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: (a) Either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; ... These requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.

requirements.text: The position, as regards width, will be determined from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis when referred to the distance between lamps.
requirements.quote: and from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis when referred to the distance between lamps.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.quote: (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; ... provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.quote: (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4);
requirements.quote: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4);
requirements.quote: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
requirements.quote: Rear retro-reflector, non- triangular: Red

requirements.text: Rear position lamps, rear direction-indicators and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, may be installed on movable components only if at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
requirements.quote: If at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.

Where the rear position lamp is installed on a movable component, the rear position lamp shall meet all the photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.

Where the rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component, the rear retro-reflector shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.

requirements.text: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., are allowed provided that the intensity of all these lamps, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.quote: (a) The intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.

requirements.text: For rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., in the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
requirements.quote: (b) In the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.

requirements.text: The presence of the reversing lamp shall be mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.
requirements.quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle shall be defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., with α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
requirements.quote: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards
atomic: Where the reversing lamp is installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility of the reversing lamp shall be 15° upwards (angle α, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.).
Where the reversing lamp is installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility of the reversing lamp shall be 5° downwards (angle α, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.).

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle shall be defined by angle β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., with β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device.
requirements.quote: β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle shall be defined by angle β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., with β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two devices.
requirements.quote: 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
atomic: Where there are two reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility of each reversing lamp shall be 45° outwards (angle β).
Where there are two reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility of each reversing lamp shall be 30° inwards (angle β).

requirements.text: The presence of stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.quote: Devices of S1 or S2 categories: mandatory on all categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The number of stop lamp devices shall be two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.quote: Two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, for stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: For S1 or S2 categories devices that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle;

requirements.text: In height, stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be positioned above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: Above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).

The S1 or S2 category stop lamps shall be not more than 1,500 mm above the ground.
If the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and the optional lamps are not installed, the S1 or S2 category stop lamps shall be not more than 2,100 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: If the optional stop lamps of S1 or S2 categories are installed, they shall be positioned at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.quote: and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: In length, stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The vertical angle of geometric visibility for stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be 15° above and below the horizontal; however, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, (a) Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°;

requirements.text: The orientation of the stop lamp shall be towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Orientation Towards the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The presence of rear position lamps of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be mandatory.
requirements.quote: Presence Devices of R or R1 or R2 categories: Mandatory

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: Number Two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
atomic: The rear position lamps shall be two in number.
The rear position lamps shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: In height, the rear position lamps shall be positioned above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).

requirements.text: In length, the rear position lamps shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In length: The rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The orientation of the rear position lamps shall be rearwards.
requirements.quote: Orientation Rearwards.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale for the rear position lamps shall be mandatory; this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.quote: Tell-tale. Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory. This requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: However, a tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamps is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.quote: However, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.

requirements.text: The presence of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles.

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.quote: Number Two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
atomic: The rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two in number.

requirements.quote: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4. below), are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.

requirements.text: In height, the rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be positioned above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).
requirements.quote: In height: Above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).

requirements.quote: in case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations and a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier is affixed, this marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that it is visible after their installation.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations and a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier is affixed, this marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
requirements.quote: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
